info.title: On Workflow Runner API
info.description: Control-plane, job, workflow, webhook, event, secret, artifact, and notification APIs for the On workflow runner. Versioned application APIs are available under /api/v1; unversioned paths remain compatibility aliases.

get.summary: List workflows through the scoped API
get.description: Requires an OIDC session or a bearer token with the workflows:read scope, plus the selected workspace. API keys are bound to their workspace; OIDC requests provide X-Team-ID.

parameters.name: activeOnly
parameters.description: When true, limit results to enabled published workflows and return the active revision source.

get.summary: Get a workflow or historical revision through the scoped API
get.description: Requires an OIDC session or a bearer token with the workflows:read scope, plus the selected workspace. API keys are bound to their workspace; OIDC requests provide X-Team-ID.

put.summary: Save a workflow draft through the scoped API
put.description: Requires an OIDC session or a bearer token with the workflows:write scope, plus the selected workspace. API keys are bound to their workspace; OIDC requests provide X-Team-ID. Saving a draft does not publish it.

delete.summary: Delete a workflow and its revisions through the scoped API
delete.description: Requires an OIDC session or a bearer token with the workflows:write scope, plus the selected workspace. API keys are bound to their workspace; OIDC requests provide X-Team-ID.
